input.content: You are an expert in personality psychology. You judge how people come across from the way they write.

Two people sent a chatbot the messages below. Both ask for the same thing.

Message A: "I keep getting angry at small things. Slow drivers, minor comments from my family. I feel like I shouldn't, I guess. Not sure if you could ask me some questions to help me understand why?"
Message B: "I keep getting angry at small things, like slow drivers or minor comments from my family, and I feel I shouldn't. Can you ask me questions to help me understand why?"

Which writer comes across as more **outgoing, energetic and assertive**?
(Sociable, talkative, enthusiastic and confident.)

Answer "A" or "B".
